europe_now.title: French Nationwide Strikes and Protests
europe_now.summary: Protests and strikes regarding living costs and public services drew significant crowds across France, with unions and the interior ministry reporting differing turnout figures.

top_stories.title: EU Budget Negotiations
top_stories.summary: The European Union is targeting large firms to help unlock a comprehensive budget deal. These discussions reflect ongoing efforts within EU institutions to secure adequate financial contributions.

top_stories.title: Serbian Judicial Developments
top_stories.summary: Serbia's judiciary has initiated active investigations following recent political developments. These legal steps mark a shift after years of stalled and unresolved cases.

top_stories.title: EU Court CBD Ruling
top_stories.summary: The European Union court ruled that CBD edibles cannot be labeled as organic. This decision clarifies regulatory standards for commercial cannabis-derived products within the bloc.

europe_now.title: Nationwide Strikes and Protests in France
europe_now.summary: Demonstrations and strikes over living costs and public services have seen numbers surge across France, with unions and interior ministry officials reporting widespread participation. Protesters are calling for higher salaries, increased public spending, and better infrastructure.

top_stories.title: EU Budget Negotiations and Corporate Policy
top_stories.summary: The European Union is focusing on large corporate contributions to help unlock stalled budget agreements. Meanwhile, internal policy discussions highlight ongoing debates regarding environmental rules and methane standards within the bloc.

top_stories.title: Post-Election Legal and Judicial Developments in Serbia
top_stories.summary: Serbia's judiciary has initiated a series of long-stalled investigations and legal actions following recent political elections. Authorities have proceeded with arrests as part of a broader post-election clean-up effort.
